about: Dove Soft is a Mumbai-based CPaaS (cloud communications) provider offering SMS, RCS, Voice, WhatsApp and Email messaging to enterprises and OTT platforms, acting as an aggregator between telecom operators and clients. It has subsidiaries Dove Soft Technologies Pvt Ltd and Dove Soft Global FZCO (Dubai). Consolidated FY26 revenue was about Rs 274 crore, with Uttar Pradesh contributing 51% of revenue.

objects.purpose: General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Rahul Bhanushali (37.42%), Kurjibhai Rupareliya (24.63%) and Sky Occean Infrastructure Ltd (11.16%) hold 73.21% pre-offer. Rahul Bhanushali and Sky Occean are selling 6,36,000 shares each in the offer for sale.

concentration.note: Top customer was 37.60% of FY26 revenue (30.61% in FY25); top 10 customers 79.94%. Top supplier accounts for 71% of costs/purchases (top 10 suppliers 92.88%). Uttar Pradesh gives 51.05% of revenue.

litigation_note: Against the Company: 5 tax proceedings (about Rs 1.42 crore). Against Promoters: 4 tax proceedings (about Rs 8.07 crore). Against Directors: 1 tax matter (Rs 0.11 lakh). Company has filed 1 criminal case (Rs 0.52 lakh). Income Tax Dept alleges accommodation entries of Rs 1 crore.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 120 crore in FY24 to Rs 274 crore in FY26, more than doubling in two years.
Profit after tax rose from Rs 10.27 crore to Rs 23.40 crore over FY24-FY26.
High return ratios: ROE 29.79% and ROCE 36.50% in FY26, well above listed peers Route Mobile (9.72%) and Tanla (20.46%).
Low leverage: borrowings of Rs 9.30 crore with debt-to-equity of 0.10 in FY26.
Annual recurring revenue grew from Rs 77 crore to Rs 157 crore, and customer churn fell from 29.16% to 19.44%.
Offers multi-channel services (SMS, RCS, Voice, WhatsApp, Email) to enterprises across telecom, BFSI, e-commerce and other sectors.
Recurring usage-based billing with master service agreements that stay valid until cancelled.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on a few customers
risks.detail: Top customer was 37.60% of FY26 revenue (30.61% in FY25) and the top 10 customers were 79.94%. Loss of a major client would sharply cut revenue.

risks.title: Dependence on very few service providers
risks.detail: Top supplier accounts for 71.00% of expenses in FY26 (59.69% FY25) and top 10 suppliers 92.88%. Reliance on channel partners and mobile network operators.

risks.title: Volatile and weak operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs 4.30 crore in FY26 against a loss of Rs 17.48 crore in FY25 and Rs 0.35 crore in FY24, as receivables swelled (47.43% of revenue in FY26).

risks.title: Income tax proceedings and accommodation-entry allegation
risks.detail: Tax department alleges the company benefited from accommodation entries of Rs 1 crore; 5 tax cases against the company (Rs 1.42 crore) and 4 against promoters (Rs 8.07 crore).

risks.title: Regional concentration
risks.detail: Uttar Pradesh alone gave 51.05% of FY26 revenue (44.41% in FY25), and North and West India together dominate sales.

risks.title: Related-party dealings and conflicts of interest
risks.detail: Subsidiary Dove Soft Technologies, group company MOS Utility and promoter group entities can carry on similar business; related-party sales and purchases with Dove Soft Technologies, E-Trav Tech and others.

risks.title: Accounts signed by non-statutory auditor and past compliance lapses
risks.detail: Restated financials were signed by a peer-reviewed auditor who is not the statutory auditor; the company has filed adjudication applications and paid penalties for delayed RoC filings.

risks.title: Regulatory and platform-misuse risk
risks.detail: The company may face claims if clients misuse its platform to send unauthorised messages in breach of TRAI rules; tech failures could disrupt services.

notes: FY26 (Mar-26) consolidated restated figures in Rs lakh converted to Rs crore. PAT is total profit for the period (before minority interest of Rs 0.52 crore in FY26). Net worth includes minority interest. Borrowings = long-term plus short-term. Operating cash flow is net cash from operating activities as given in the cash flow summary. Weighted avg EPS is the basic weighted figure (diluted 9.74). Price band, issue size in Rs, P/E and post-issue holdings are blank in the RHP. Reservation percentages computed on net offer of 62,70,000 shares from share counts (QIB 64,800; NII 30,70,800; retail 31,34,400). Working capital amount Rs 46 crore from net proceeds. Peer CMP not given. Revenue shown for peers converted from lakh.
